B: keeps the original stack centred with the CTA under the headline, but it is basically a shrunk copy; the block sits low (big top margin, tight bottom margin) and the CTA text is small.

B: headline hugs the bottom under dead space at the top, and the CTA floats at the top right, jammed against the right edge and not aligned with anything, which breaks reading order and grouping.
